title: Great Design but Really Cheap Shirt
text:
I had read from some other reviewers that the shirt quality was lacking, I have to second that opinion. For $17.99, I expected better than a free T-shirt giveaway quality shirt (that might even be speaking too negatively of some free t-shirts).

I really like the design and would be interested in keeping this subscription if the quality was even mediocre, but instead I am going to return this shirt and cancel the subscription going forward.
label: neutral
